Subject: Quick alignment: POC MAP checklist and onboarding items

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers. We want to lock the mutual action plan so our engineering team can schedule the POC work next week. Two asks to start:

1) A concise checklist we can hand to our infra team for tenant bootstrap (org + service account creation).
2) A simple allowlist CSV and VPC peering window recommendations (preferred maintenance hours).

Can you send a single MAP doc with milestones we can share internally? Also include who at Redwood will own API key provisioning and the expected TTL/rotation for ephemeral keys.

Alex

Subject: Re: Quick alignment: POC MAP checklist and onboarding items

Alex — thanks, happy to put a compact MAP together. High level below; I attached a starter SOW and our allowlist template for your infra team (see attachments).

Key ownership and immediate asks:
- Tenant bootstrap / org seeds: Solstice creates the org tenant and a dedicated service account (instructions in allowlist CSV).
- API keys: Redwood will generate a scoped ephemeral key for the POC once we receive the service-account email and IP ranges. Key TTL: default 24h for early testing; can be extended to 7d for longer-running jobs upon agreement.
- IP allowlist: we prefer an explicit range (single /24 or a small set). Use the attached network-allowlist-template.csv to populate.
- VPC peering: target window = weekday maintenance window 02:00–06:00 PT; we can do weekend alternative if required. Peering requires a short change-control entry from your networking team (we can accept the PR or the change ticket id).

Proposed MAP milestones (short):
1) Today: Solstice returns filled allowlist template + service-account email (owner: Solstice infra).
2) +24–48h: Redwood issues scoped POC API key and test endpoints (owner: Vivek / Marissa).
3) +72h: Simple smoke tests (connectivity and token auth) and ephemeral-key rotation check (owner: Solstice eng + Redwood ops).
4) Day 5–10: Full workload run and performance gating (owner: Solstice product + Redwood success).

I've attached the SOW draft and allowlist CSV. Marissa / Priyom are copied to track SOW redlines and procurement steps. Ben — can you pre-authorize a small peering slot on the infra calendar if Solstice requests a weekend?

Deliverables attached: solstice-sow-draft.pdf, network-allowlist-template.csv

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Vivek — thanks, this is helpful. Couple clarifications from our infra/security team after a quick scan: 

- Service account: we'll create a read-only service account for telemetry and a write-capable service account for model invocation. Do you require separate keys per account, or can we use a single scoped key?
- Ephemeral key TTL: security prefers 12h for initial POC. Is 12h compatible with the token refresh flow you expect?
- Peering: we need guidance on expected BGP CIDR and whether there are specific egress SNAT expectations. Our ops lead (procurement@solstice-health.com) will supply the filled CSV by EOD tomorrow.

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute call Tuesday to go through the checklist with Marissa and Priyom.

Alex

Alex / team — looping back with an updated mutual action plan and answers to the infra Qs. I also attached an annotated allowlist and a trimmed SOW for procurement.

Short answers:
- Separate keys: we recommend a distinct scoped key per service account (invocation vs telemetry). Keeps audit + rotation simple for the POC.
- TTL: 12h is fine for the initial run. We'll include a refresh token flow (documented) so your runners can request a replacement before expiry.
- Peering/BGP: Redwood accepts standard routed peering. Preferred egress: no SNAT on Redwood side; advertise the Solstice CIDR to our edge. We will provide an ASN and suggested CIDR mask in the peering ticket.

Action card (owners + ETA):
- Solstice: return filled network-allowlist-template.csv + service-account emails (ETA: 2027-03-17 EOD)
- Redwood (Vivek / Marissa): issue scoped keys and share test endpoint + ephemeral key refresh docs (ETA: 2027-03-18 11:00 PT)
- Redwood (Ben): confirm peering maintenance slot once Solstice requests (ETA: 24h after request)
- Procurement (Priyom): send SOW and DocuSign link for signature once redlines are returned (ETA: 2 business days after SOW acceptance)

Links / artifacts: HubSpot deal RW-2027-6473, DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
